card.name: Digits and decimal points in percentages
card.fires_on: Numbers inside adverse-event and lab tables, mainly the decimal point or a digit just before the % sign. It fires in percentages like 57.6, 10.5% or 21.9%.

modes.label: Decimal point
modes.description: The period between whole and fractional digits of a percentage.
modes.example: the incidence of edema was 21<<.>>9% in the OPSUMIT

modes.label: Digit in percentage
modes.description: A digit inside a percent value in a table cell.
modes.example: 5 (<<7>>1%) In the combination study of B
